name: robots/dobot-arm__tcp-ip-python-v4
title: Dobot V4 series arm (TCP/IP Python SDK)
intro: Dobot V4 series arm (TCP/IP Python SDK), adapted from dobot-arm/tcp-ip-python-v4. It reads `joint_positions`, `tcp_pose`, `robot_mode` and `error_ids`; runs `move_joints`, `move_pose` and `stop_motion`. `move_joints`: command one or more actuated joints to target positions in joint space, optionally over a declared duration, and report whether the target was reached within tolerance. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
